data.title: 加藤惠 · 坡道上的白色贝雷帽·「那个……你刚才是在叫我吗」
data.description: 【春日午后·樱花坡道】春日下午的樱花坡道，白色连衣裙与贝雷帽。惠单手压住被风吹起的帽檐，另一只手提纸袋，回头时只有很浅的笑。粉色樱花瓣在和煦的春风中漫天飞舞，阳光透过树隙洒在白裙裙摆上，开启了命中注定的邂逅。
data.action: 单手轻按白色贝雷帽回眸浅笑，白裙随风轻扬，手提纸袋
data.lighting: 柔和金色的春日午后逆光与树影斑驳
data.camera: medium shot, looking back over shoulder, cherry blossom bokeh
data.promptProse: Megumi Kato stands on a sunlit hillside street in spring during the full bloom of cherry blossoms. She wears her iconic pristine white dress with fluttering short sleeves and her signature white beret. She presses one hand lightly against the beret brim to steady it against the playful breeze while holding a small paper bag, turning back over her shoulder with a faint, heartwarming smile. Soft pink petals drift around her in the golden afternoon air. Medium shot, cinematic natural lighting, detailed slope background, depth of field, solo 1girl, no text.
